Which Roof Wins

STS-HS10-L2-1400P-HSGEO-LEC-IMR-02 • HS Math Geometry Grade 10 • Special Right Triangles (30-60-90 and 45-45-90)
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
The Newcomer Garden Club runs this greenhouse, and the jars on the seed wall came here with families from far away. The seedlings have to live until the spring plant sale, so the club is running one clean test: same soil, same water, same lamp, and only the roof angle changed. Roof A rises at 45 degrees and its two short sides are both 4 feet. Roof B rises at 30 degrees, its short side is 4 feet, and its slope is exactly 8 feet.
Roof B's slope is exactly double its short side. Roof A's sides are both 4 feet, so why is its slope not 8 feet too?
